full-local.describe: 24 GB+ VRAM (or multi-GPU). Everything local — the reference experience.
full-local.llm: Serve a 30-35B-class MoE at Q4 with llama.cpp / LM Studio / Ollama / vLLM and point config.llm.baseUrl at it. See docs/choosing-your-llm.md.
full-local.search: qmd with GPU embeddings and reranking on — best quality.

small-gpu.describe: 8-16 GB VRAM. Fully local with a smaller model.
small-gpu.llm: Serve a 4-14B model at Q4 locally. See docs/choosing-your-llm.md for the tier table.
small-gpu.search: qmd with GPU embeddings and reranking on.

cpu-only.describe: No GPU. Local memory + search; inference is the honest tradeoff.
cpu-only.llm: Small GGUF models run on CPU but cycle slowly; a hosted API (config.llm.provider anthropic/openai + apiKeyEnv) is usually the honest choice — memory stays local, prompts reach the provider.
cpu-only.search: qmd runs its GGUF embedding model on CPU — fine for thousands of markdown docs. Skip reranking (use search/vsearch, not query). If indexing is still too slow: set services.search.backend to "local-bm25" (zero-dep, built in) or use a hosted embedding API — with the data-locality tradeoff that implies.

api-first.llm: config.llm { provider: "anthropic" | "openai", model, apiKeyEnv } — no baseUrl. Memory stays on disk here; prompts quoting it reach the provider.

apple-silicon.describe: Apple Silicon Mac, 32 GB+ unified memory. Everything local on Metal.
apple-silicon.llm: Serve via llama.cpp (Metal), LM Studio or an MLX server and point config.llm.baseUrl at it. Unified memory makes 30B+ MoE models comfortable from 64 GB.
apple-silicon.search: qmd runs its GGUF embeddings on Metal — rerank on. STT: --with whisper renders a whisper.cpp server (brew install whisper-cpp ffmpeg; set WHISPER_MODEL to a ggml model path).
